verdict.rationale: Signifyd exposes a full REST API (Sale, Checkout, webhooks, decision retrieval) that can technically be called from scripts or CI pipelines without any UI, which supports headless automation in principle. However, there is no explicit documentation of CLI tools, CI/CD integration guides, or automation-specific tooling — the story is only inferred from generic API availability. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless-usage documentation, CLI or automation-specific tooling, and any example of running Signifyd checks in a pipeline context.
